map.首次使用请设置主密码，用于加密保管你的口令。主密码无法找回，请务必牢记。: On first use please set a master password to encrypt and store your passwords. The master password cannot be recovered, so be sure to memorize it.
map.设置主密码后用 XOR 异或 + Base64 在浏览器本地加密保管账号口令，主: After setting a master password, use XOR plus Base64 to encrypt stored account passwords locally in the browser; the master password is never stored in plaintext.
map.添加口令时实时检测强度，弱密码提示换用字母+数字+符号且不少于 8 位。: Strength is checked live as you add an entry; weak ones suggest using letters plus digits plus symbols and at least 8 characters.
map.导出加密备份（JSON）并在换设备时导入迁移，数据仅存本机不上传。: Export an encrypted backup (JSON) and import it when moving devices; data stays on this machine and is never uploaded.
map.：口令强度按 7 项加 1：长度≥8、≥12、含小写、含大写、含数字、含符号；得: : password strength adds 1 per item across 7 checks: length at least 8, at least 12, contains lowercase, contains uppercase, contains digits, contains symbols; a score of at most 2 is weak, at most 4 is medium, otherwise strong. Generated passwords default to 16 characters from a set of upper and lower case letters plus digits plus symbols with confusable characters removed (about 56 characters). Encryption is password[i] XOR key[i % key.length] byte by byte, then Base64.
map.：abc123 仅含小写+数字得 2 分→弱；Abcd1234! 含大小写+数字: : abc123 with only lowercase plus digits scores 2 -> weak; Abcd1234! with upper and lower case plus digits plus symbols and length at least 8 scores 6 -> strong. The encryption key pw XORs the plaintext byte by byte and then Base64 encodes it; decryption needs the same master password.
map.忘记主密码能找回吗？: Can a forgotten master password be recovered?
map.不能。主密码不存储明文，忘记将无法解密保管库；请牢记或妥善保存加密备份文件。: No. The master password is never stored in plaintext, so forgetting it makes the vault undecryptable; memorize it or keep an encrypted backup file safe.
map.属于基础混淆，适合日常防窥屏与本地保管，并非军用级；敏感账号建议仍使用专业密码管: It is basic obfuscation, fine for everyday screen privacy and local storage, not military grade; for sensitive accounts still use a professional password manager and two-factor authentication.
